shelfmark: UTO Sinai Syriac NF M 37, SPP No. 81

note: Follows the text of the Old Syriac Gospel; John 1:47-2:12 is not otherwise attested in the Old Syriac version; there is a lacuna in both the Curetonianus (British Library, Add. 14451) and Sinaiticus Syriacus (Sinai Syr. 30) at this point

program.label: Sinai Palimpsests Project
program.description: Imaged and studied as part of the Sinai Palimpsests Project (2011–2016), a collaboration between St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, funded by the Arcadia Fund and the Ahmanson Foundation. The project used multispectral imaging and scholarly analysis to recover and document erased and obscured texts in palimpsest manuscripts from the monastery’s collection.

note.value: All three UTOs of Sinai Syriac NF M 37 belong to a single Old Syriac Gospel manuscript, to which the four UTOs of Sinai Syriac NF M 39 also belong. F. 1v is followed by Sinai Syriac NF M 39, f. 9, and f. 6r is preceded by Sinai Syriac NF M 39, f. 16v
